newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Oryol says plans $100 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Oryol says plans $100 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's Oryol region plans to issue $100 million in Eurobonds within the next three years, including an initial tranche of $35-$40 million, a regional official said.

"We are not going to place a significant volume," Deputy Governor for finance Tamara Kravchenko told Reuters. "We are talking about $35-$40 million, but the total (Eurobond) volume will be $100 million."

Kravchenko said Oryol was in talks with France's Societe Generale on appointing it a lead-manager of the issue. The region also hoped to name Russia's Bank Derzhava and the All-Russian Bank For Regional Development advisers in the issue, she said.
Kravchenko said the issue would be placed on the French and other European markets. The proceeds would be invested in industrial projects, including in the food-processing sector, Kravchenko said.
Oryol region joins a long line of Russian regions, including Irkutsk, Perm and Samara regions, which are preparing Eurobond issues.
Russia has already made three sovereign Eurobond issues, while in recent months the City of Moscow and St Petersburg have also successfully tapped international markets.
